title: I neraida kai to palikari
actors: Aliki Vougiouklaki, Dimitris Papamichael, Dionysis Papagiannopoulos
plot: Captivated by the stranger who arrived at her engagement, a spirited woman unaware of his identity forgets the vendetta between their clans. Is love alone potent enough to quench her thirst for revenge, and pave the way for a truce?
